text:
Maya: quick one  can we do a mid-cycle promo + salary change?

Hector (People Ops): yes, but submit the comp-change form. title-only goes through title-update. Links in the playbook.

Maya: payroll timing?

forms-bot: payroll cutoff: submit by the 7th for next-month effective. late -> next cycle.

Raj (Eng Lead): what speeds approvals?

Zoe (Comp): include redacted offer if any, 2-3 market comps, manager bullets (impact + retention risk). mark urgent if time-sensitive.

Maya: if it exceeds band max?

Zoe (Comp): anything above band max needs VP People + Finance signoff. >20% may need exec approval.

Raj (Eng Lead): fallback options if denied?

Hector (People Ops): suggested levers: one-time retention bonus, title-only now + salary later, equity refresh. use manager playbook script for denials.

Maya: appeal route?

Hector (People Ops): managers can request re-review with more evidence. escalate to me + Zoe with form ticket ID.

Maya: intl hires? currency?

Zoe (Comp): propose local currency + USD equivalent; legal reviews equity conversion. note earlier cutoffs for some regions.

Maya: thanks, I'll file the form and ping for a pre-check. :thumbsup:
